AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Imperatofu: Name Beyond Origin
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was of unknown origin and limited in power, wandering the world without conviction. When the Revolutionary War began, they were invited by a former leader to join the cause and rose onto the stage of history. The revolutionary army was betrayed by allies, and the leader fell in battle, but [PAWN_nameDef] survived and carried the weight of the revolution forward.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Imperatofu: I Rule by My Name
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: After leading the revolutionary army to victory, [PAWN_nameDef] established the first Ice Moon Council at the stronghold and then withdrew into seclusion. All the soldiers and civilians thereafter called themselves Furi. Neighboring states formed an alliance to confront Ice Moon, and the need to defend the nation and the people led [PAWN_nameDef] to return to power and continue guiding the realm.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Imperasofu: Veteran of the Front
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was of unknown origin, skilled in close combat and ranged magic, and was the strongest melee mage in the revolutionary army. Their near-universal intelligence made them one of the key figures of the revolution. Over time, they grew close to the blood moon and became a strategic adviser and a right-hand figure in the war effort, eventually earning the trust of the leadership.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Imperasofu: Crowned Sovereign
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: After rising with the Blood Moon, [PAWN_nameDef] alone managed the affairs of Ice Moon, overseeing military, civilian life, diplomacy, and internal governance with impeccable care. Their subordinates had nothing left to do, and at the same time, they helped share the burden of the Blood Moon in managing the nation. They became the co-ruler behind the throne and one of the most important figures in the realm's political and military order.
